requirement.summary: Does not reload business setup completely if executing daily start platform page
requirement.description:
When the "Daily start force reload business setup" configuration is turned on, executing daily‑start via the platform fails to load the business setup correctly.

Pre-condition:

1. Setting force reload business day for daily start

* Location: System Management > System Configuration

* Select POS Module

* Section: Under Basic Configuration

> Setup name: Daily start force reload business setup

>> Setting value as "Yes" (Modifying this configuration requires a service restart for the changes to take effect)

Workflow:

1. Go to platform setup page: POS System > Tools

2. Select "Daily Start and Close" or "Auto Daily Start and Close"

3. Daily Close with target outlet if necessary

4. Go to platform setup page: POS System > Ordering Setup > Split Revenue Settings

5. Add a new Split Revenue Item

6. Proceed with step 1 and step 2

7. Execute daily start with target outlet

8. After the daily start is completed

10. Login POS Client with the outlet

Actual result : Inspection reveals that the newly added split revenue item failed to take effect

Expected result: :

- Daily start through the platform; the system will load business setup normally and the newly‑added split revenue item will work as expected.
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68691] Does not reload business setup completely if executing daily start platform page (Paker)
Descriptions:
System failed to load the business setup when daily start via the platform if the setting “Daily start force reload business setup” is turned ON
Workflow
1. Go to platform setup page: POS System  Tools
2.	Select “Daily Start and Close” or “Auto Daily Start and Close”
3.	Daily Close with target outlet if necessary
4.	Go to platform setup page: POS System  Ordering Setup  Split Revenue Settings
5.	Add a new Split Revenue record
6.	Proceed with step 1 and step 2
7.	Execute daily start with target outlet
8.	After the daily start is completed
9.	Login POS Client with the outlet
10. Inspection reveals that the newly added split revenue item failed to take effect
Expected result:
Daily start through the platform, the system will load business setup normally and the newly added split revenue item will work as expected
It is fixed in current version
Setup:
Add a setup under Config by Location
Go to Infrasys POS platform: System Management  System Configuration  Config by Location
Select “POS Module”
Click button “Edit”
Under section “Basic Configuration”, select
Daily start force reload business setup = Yes
Click “Save” to save record
